title: Wire the Q1 travel-behaviour model into Q2/Q4

settings.note: Full-scale run: 21_q2_opt.py multiplies dep/arr by SCALE=1/0.128 inside load_demand(). LP equations unchanged (conservation is T007).
T006 only switches the demand surface; Q4 siting/sizing unchanged (capacity fixes are T009). Both surfaces are full-scale via 1/0.128 and share the same daily total.

root_docs.note: DATA.md/README.md changed after the T015 baseline but were already committed and clean before T006 started (mtime 00:54/00:02, runs/T006 created 01:03); T006 wrote neither.

code_changes.what: rebuild training-day D_j and A_j per band, form row-normalised P(j|i,h), generate arr_q1_cell and od_q1, save q1_od.npz and q1_vs_obs.json
code_changes.why: the problem text requires Q2/Q4 to use the Q1 model.

code_changes.what: argparse --od q1|obs and --out; q1 reads q1_od.npz and defaults to data/runs/T006/q2_state_q1.npz
code_changes.why: input switch without touching the tracked q2_state.npz.

code_changes.what: argparse --od q1|obs (q1 default), --conserve ready for T007; load_demand() reads the selected OD surface and multiplies dep/arr by SCALE=1/0.128 (PZ stays row-normalised)
code_changes.why: input switch at the full 343,638-bike scale; equations untouched for T006.

code_changes.what: argparse --od q1|obs (q1 default); od_hr from q1_od.npz or typical_day.npz
code_changes.why: input switch; greedy capacity fix is T007.

code_changes.what: argparse --arr q1|obs, --outdir, --radii, --reps; q1 hourly demand split into four 15-min slots; writes only under --outdir
code_changes.why: Q4 must use the Q1 demand surface; tracked q4_* files stay read-only.

notes: Q1 OD is built on the same five training days as T005 (2017-05-10/11/15/16/18); A_j is recomputed from those days and not stored, so P cannot be re-derived from q1_od.npz alone.
The model over-predicts same-cell stays: 12.83% vs 8.89% observed (+3.94 pp). This must be written as an overestimate, not as agreement.
The distance KS is 0.0524 with 0.5 km bins; the model and the observed histogram use the same 7 typical days.
Q2 smoke runs use conserve=False: T006 was forbidden to change the LP equations, so these smoke numbers are not the final conservation result. H13 is T007.
21_q2_opt.py still takes I0 from data/q2_state.npz, i.e. the observed last-end distribution, for both OD surfaces. That is the common initial state, not a demand input.

20_q2_diag.py was run with --od q1 and wrote data/runs/T006/q2_state_q1.npz; the tracked data/q2_state.npz was not touched. Its net/cum/req arrays inherit the sampled demand scale, while I0 is full-scale (343,638); they are diagnostics at different scales, so multiply req by 1/0.128 before using it with I0 or any full-scale Q2 result.

22_q2_sim.py was compiled and its --od switch was checked in the source, but not executed: it still writes data/q2_sim.json and reads data/q2_plan.npz, both tracked. T007 runs it with the new plan and conservation fix.

Q4 splits each Q1 hourly total into four equal 15-min slots (divide by 4). An earlier version repeated the hourly total four times and produced 4x the observed daily arrivals (8,573,670 vs 2,143,417); that run was discarded and the corrected runs agree to 1.4e-10 relative.

Q4 Q1 demand is more diffuse than observed: 696 fences vs 626, coverage 76.4% vs 75.3%, but total 95th-percentile capacity 281,941 vs 344,463 slots (-18.2%). This is a sanity run only; T009 owns the Q4 capacity fix.

The 1/p expansion is applied downstream in one place per script: 21_q2_opt.py multiplies dep/arr by SCALE=1/0.128 inside load_demand (PZ stays row-normalised), 22_q2_sim.py multiplies od_hr by SCALE, and 40_q4_efence.py multiplies by the same SCALE. All three therefore work at the full 343,638-bike scale.

R1 fix: the first T006 submission refactored 21_q2_opt.py without restoring the SCALE multiplication, so the LP served sampled demand with a full-scale fleet (trips=274,357). With SCALE applied inside load_demand, the observed-surface run at alpha=1, K=60, fixed_K_cost=600 reproduces the pre-refactor row: moved 23,959.15, truck-km 5,440.94, dev 900.00, obj 83,325.24, trips 2,143,417. The Q1-surface run is now full-scale too: moved 24,679.28, truck-km 5,529.85, dev 225.36, obj 82,194.80.
No file under paper/, review/ or 审查与规划/ was written. data/ was only extended under data/runs/T006/.
